title: IAMMAI v1 State Record Body
description: Canonical state record body schema for v1. This schema defines the state record as artifact only. It preserves typed protocol-relevant state standing without carrying execution, envelope, registry, preservation, or transport context as canonical body content.

state_id.description: Artifact identity for the state record body. This is not execution or envelope identity.

matter_ref.description: Canonical reference to the bounded matter within which the state stands.

state_family.description: Canonical state family. This preserves primary state identity only and does not encode containment or execution context as family.

state_type.description: Canonical state identity bounded by the selected state family. HOLD and generic status values are not valid state identities.

recorded_at.description: Time at which the canonical state record was recorded.

predecessor_ref.description: Optional primary lineage reference to the prior state where lineage-bearing succession is part of current state standing.

related_transition_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related transition record where that relation is part of state standing.

related_governance_action_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related governance action record where that relation is part of state standing.

related_validation_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related validation artifact where that relation is part of state standing.

related_witness_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related witness artifact where that relation is part of state standing.

containment_ref.description: Optional bounded reference to orthogonal containment where containment relation affects the effective standing condition without replacing canonical state identity.
